name: allinluna
description: Plan and run complete, resource-aware agent development workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and run complete agent development workflows
interface.longDescription: Inspect an existing repository or greenfield idea, plan complete work, choose explicit model and reasoning profiles, coordinate isolated parallel tasks, and resume long-running development without shrinking scope.
defaultPrompt: Plan this project with independent owner lanes as user-visible top-level Codex tasks; each owner may use bounded internal subagents and no Goal is created.
Execute this plan through top-level Codex task owners; owners may use bounded internal subagents, but the root must not replace owner tasks with subagents.
Resume the saved All in Luna workflow through top-level owners and their bounded internal subagents.
使用 All in Luna 规划项目：独立主体线路默认为用户可见的顶层 Codex 任务，每个负责人可使用有界子代理，不创建 Goal。
通过顶层 Codex 任务负责人完整执行计划；负责人可使用有界子代理，但根协调不得用子代理替代顶层主体任务。
通过顶层负责人及其有界内部子代理恢复 All in Luna 开发流程。
